item.title: Exercise has 'similar effect' to therapy, study on depression shows
item.description:
📝 That's according to researchers from the UK's University of Lancashire, who have concluded that exercise has "a similar effect on depressive symptoms" to therapy, following an examination of 73 randomized control trials involving around 5,000 patients. The trials were less conclusive when it came to comparing exercise with medication. Citation: Exercise has 'similar effect' to therapy, study on depression shows (2026, January 23) retrieved 20 February 2026 from https://medicalxpress.
🔗 Read more: https://medicalxpress.com/news/2026-01-similar-effect-therapy-depression.html

item.title: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 at 873.5MHz with 3.05V Core Abuse
item.description:
📝 When I first got my hands on the RP2350 datasheet, one thing I noticed rather quickly was that the voltage regulator could have the voltage limit disabled, so that voltages above 1. 35V wasn't as much as would be expected, and on further investigation the voltage that the voltage regulator was supplying didn't actually make it above about 2. That would mean we could use a bench power supply to provide as much voltage and current as the Pico 2 could take.
🔗 Read more: https://learn.pimoroni.com/article/overclocking-the-pico-2
